bounds: pattern backtracking: V8 has no bound (the recorded repetitions holding a lookaround take Node about a second on 24 characters that fail, each more character doubling it). The core matches with fancy-regex bounded at 10,000,000,000 backtracking steps (mixdog-mcp output_schema.rs BACKTRACK_LIMIT; about 32 such characters, which Node answers in some minutes); every recorded case finishes well inside it and gives Node's answer. A match that runs out of steps has no verdict, and the call answers -32602 "Failed to validate structured content: data<path>: its pattern needs more than 10000000000 backtracking steps".
exclusions: a chain of between about 2500 and 6900 references: Node b6f10295a compiles a chain of 1000 and overflows on 10000, and in between its answer depends on how far V8 has optimized Ajv's code (a fresh process overflows from about 2500-2750, a warmed one from about 6900; two recordings answered a chain of 3000 differently), so no chain in that band is recorded. The core cuts at 5000 (mixdog-mcp ajv_stack.rs STACK_LIMIT): a compile chain, or a validation path, of more than 5000 references answers -32602 "Failed to validate structured content: Maximum call stack size exceeded", and one of 5000 or fewer validates.
normalized: cases["a reference to a remote address is never fetched"]: tools[remote].outputSchema.properties.v.$ref, connect and remote name the per-run listener as http://127.0.0.1:<port>; the replay moves it to a listener of its own
